title: South Nashville Studio - Peaceful & Central
description:
Enjoy all Nashville has to offer in this conveniently located, remodeled studio. The studio offers a fully outfitted bright kitchen, designated working space, private terrace, guest entrance and free parking. It is centrally located, an easy 10 minutes to downtown and 7 minutes to the airport. Located in a small and quiet neighborhood, you will love this peaceful pocket of the city.

The space
Recently renovated last year, this studio features an open floor plan thoughtfully styled and filled with natural light. 

Additional Highlights Include:
*Tree lined private terrace with a view of the Tennessee hills
*Fully outfitted kitchen with bar seating 
*Dedicated parking spot in driveway 
*Pillow top Queen mattress 
*Full bath with shower/tub combo
*Smart TV with Netflix, Hulu, HBO and more

Guest access
Guests have full and private access to the studio, terrace and guest only entrance. While there is a single dedicated spot in the driveway, guests are welcome to park along the street in front of the home.

Other things to note
The studio is located on top of the garage. Guests must be able to climb 1 flight of stairs to access the entrance. The stairs are well lit with hand rails and additional tread for ease of use in dark or rainy conditions.
